methodology: scripts/file-size-scan.sh counts nonblank physical lines per section 3 (a line counts if it has any non-whitespace character; matches ESLint max-lines with skipBlankLines). Entries below exceed the REVIEW THRESHOLD column of the section 3 table, not the softer target column. blobSha is the git blob hash of the file at generatedFromCommit, recorded so a future run can detect the file changed without relying on line numbers as an identifier per section 14. Categories: react-component, custom-hook, java-controller, java-service, utility-api-client, test-file. Function/method-level (40/60 line) violations are not covered by this registry, no AST tooling was available in the environment that generated it; treat that dimension as unmeasured, not clean.
